source_name: SAM.gov Entity Management (System for Award Management)
license: Public extract released under FOIA (Public sensitivity level only)
access: authenticated (free SAM.gov account + API key, System Account with 'Read Public')
planning_only_reason: Requires a free SAM.gov account + API key (authentication). Not downloaded in this investigation. Fields below are cataloged from public SAM.gov API documentation / source-inventory notes only; no raw records, observed values, or extracted field values are copied here. Use only the FOIA-releasable Public extract; do not request or store FOUO/Sensitive data.

fields.meaning: Unique Entity ID (SAM) — the 12-character federal identifier that replaced the DUNS number for entities doing business with the US government. Primary key.
fields.limitations: Planning-only (documented, not observed). Identifies federal-registered entities (contractors/grantees) only.
fields.analysis_notes: Federal primary key for contractors/grantees; distinct from CIK and EIN.

fields.meaning: Commercial And Government Entity (CAGE) code — assigned to suppliers to government agencies.
fields.limitations: Planning-only. Present for entities with a CAGE assignment.
fields.analysis_notes: Secondary federal identifier; useful join to defense/procurement datasets.

fields.meaning: Legal business name registered with SAM.gov.
SAM registration status (e.g. Active, Expired) for federal-award eligibility.
fields.limitations: Planning-only. Status reflects federal-registration validity, not state corporate standing.
fields.analysis_notes: Distinct meaning from state 'entitystatus' — keep separate.

fields.meaning: Dates the SAM registration was created and when it expires.
fields.limitations: Planning-only. Registration dates, NOT company incorporation date.

fields.meaning: Physical business address (line1/line2, city, stateOrProvinceCode, zipCode, countryCode).
fields.limitations: Planning-only. A separate mailingAddress may also exist.

fields.meaning: Legal/organizational structure of the entity (e.g. corporate entity, partnership, sole proprietor).
fields.analysis_notes: Field path/name approximate per public docs; verify against a real response.

fields.meaning: List of NAICS (North American Industry Classification System) codes describing the entity's lines of business, with a primary-NAICS flag.
fields.analysis_notes: NAICS is the richest standardized industry classification available across US sources; map into activity section.

fields.meaning: Federal tax id of the entity.
fields.limitations: Planning-only AND typically restricted/redacted in the Public (FOIA) extract — TIN/EIN is sensitive. Do not assume it is available in the public tier.
fields.analysis_notes: If exposed, EIN would join to IRS EO BMF; but treat as usually-unavailable in the public extract.
